title: Lux-Mountain Estate - Pickleball, Epic Pool, Spa!
description: The Harlow: your dream home in a private desert oasis. Nestled into the side of Camelback Mountain, this entertainer's paradise has breathtaking views of the Phoenix skyline. Built to impress, this 5,000-square-foot modern masterpiece has been featured in Uptown Magazine for fine design and architecture. Resort-style amenities include a heated negative edge pool and spa, billiards room, multi-room sound system, bocce ball/mini golf, firepit, and much more. Book your dream vacation today.

review_snippets: This home is in the top 10% of eligible listings based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

This home was fantastic. We had a group of 12 guys stay here for a fantasy football draft weekend. The space was great, kitchen and living room was great size for everyone to hang. Pool was fantastic. Garage was another cool area to hang. We also played a little pickle and pool. Excellent location 10 mins to everything in Scottsdale. Would highly recommend.

Amazing Airbnb for large groups. The house is in excellent shape and has plenty of space to accommodate many people. The outside grounds are expansive and well maintained. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay, I would definitely book this property again in the future!

The house was amazing and was adequate for the 16 people on the trip. There were amazing views and a nice neighborhood as well as all the amazing amenities. There is a really well equipped kitchen with utensils, dishes and cookware in addition to a laundry room. Also, there is sports equipment provided for use on the courts. One small thing to note is the master suite essentially contains two rooms with a common entry.
